cards.text: Friend, John is still in the middle of his vision from heaven, and it has been a LOT. Then he looks up and sees another mighty angel coming down from heaven.

cards.question: This mighty angel coming down from heaven is wrapped in something. What is it?

cards.text: There's a rainbow above his head, his face is like the sun, and his legs are like pillars of fire. Me? I've got a gold base and a mustache, and I thought THAT was making an entrance.

cards.question: The mighty angel holds a small scroll lying open in his hand. Then he plants his feet, and he covers a whole lot of ground. Where do his feet go?

answers.text: One on the sea and one on the land
Both on the Mount of Olives
Both on the steps of the temple

cards.text: Then the angel cries out in a loud voice like the roar of a lion. And something answers him.

cards.question: When the mighty angel cries out like a roaring lion, who sounds their voices?

cards.text: When the seven thunders have spoken, John is about to put it all in writing. Pen up, ready to go, like me the second I hear a new cookie recipe.

cards.question: John never writes down what the seven thunders said. Why not?

answers.text: A voice from heaven told him to seal it up
The thunders were too loud to understand
He forgot the words before he could start

cards.text: Seven thunders talk, and John has to keep it ALL sealed up. Friend, back in the junk drawer I couldn't even keep a secret from the twist tie.
Big moment. The angel standing on the sea and on the land lifts his right hand to heaven.

cards.question: With his right hand raised to heaven, the mighty angel swears an oath. Who does he swear by?

answers.text: Him who lives forever and ever

cards.text: He describes Him as the One who created heaven, the earth and the sea, and everything in them. Then comes the oath itself, and it's all about timing.

cards.question: The mighty angel swears there will be no more ___.

cards.text: Then the angel points ahead to the seventh angel, the one who hasn't sounded his trumpet yet. Six trumpets down, one to go.

cards.question: The angel says something will be fulfilled when the seventh angel begins to sound his trumpet. What is it?
The angel says the mystery of God will be fulfilled just as God proclaimed it to His servants the prophets.

cards.text: Then the voice John heard from heaven speaks to him again. And this time, it gives him a job.

cards.question: The voice from heaven speaks to John again and gives him a job. What is it?

answers.text: Take the small scroll from the angel
Write a letter to the seven churches
Count the servants who were sealed

cards.text: So John walks up to the mighty angel standing on the sea and on the land and says, “Give me the small scroll.” Friend, I'd need three tries just to get out "excuse me."

cards.question: John asks the mighty angel for the small scroll. What does the angel tell him to do with it?
The angel says the small scroll will be ___ in John's mouth but ___ in his stomach.

cards.text: So John takes the small scroll from the angel's hand and eats it. A SCROLL, friend, and here I am feeling guilty for licking a little dough off my mustache!

cards.question: When John eats the small scroll, it turns out exactly the way the angel said it would.

cards.text: Sweet in his mouth, bitter in his stomach. And now John hears what comes next for him.

cards.question: After eating the small scroll, John is told what he must do next. What is it?

answers.text: Prophesy again about many peoples and kings
Wait in silence for the last trumpet
Go back to Patmos and rest awhile

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave John for now, with a big job ahead of him. Stick with me, friend, because this story is far from over.
